name: PriceLabs
positioning: Dynamic pricing for short-term rentals, with the reasoning visible instead of hidden in a black box.
description: PriceLabs sets nightly rates for short-term rental listings using market demand data, seasonality, day-of-week patterns and booking pace, with customisable rules, minimum-stay optimisation and a market dashboard covering comparable listings.
real_estate_use: Nightly pricing is the single biggest lever on STR revenue and the one humans handle worst — most hosts set a rate and forget it. PriceLabs adjusts every listing daily against local demand, and its market dashboard is widely used before acquisition, to check what comparable properties in a neighbourhood actually earn across a year.
features: Dynamic nightly pricing driven by market demand signals
Customisable rules, floors, ceilings and seasonal overrides
Market dashboards with comparable listing performance
Portfolio view across many listings and channels

use_cases.job: Reprice every listing daily against local demand instead of setting and forgetting
Check what comparable short-term rentals in a neighbourhood actually earn before buying

capabilities: Demand forecasting and dynamic rate setting
